headline: Paused: all agents stopped at a usage limit. Work committed and pushed to GitHub; resume in a new or cloud session.

pieces.name: Foundation & engine
pieces.verdict: HF2 wins 4/4 blind pairs: engine renders evenly soft overcast-looking light; locked 60 fps but 0.4-0.7 s post-entry freeze
pieces.gap: Lighting is shadowless and evenly soft: furniture and fixtures cast no sun or lamp shadows, there is no coloured bounce and contact AO is weak, so every frame reads as overcast and flat next to HF2's contrasty sun shafts and light pools.

pieces.name: House shell (Blender pipeline)
pieces.verdict: HF2 wins 5-0 blind; stairs unclimbable, terrace/balcony/front door unreachable, floating balusters, street facade misses key client features
pieces.gap: The shell is not playable as architecture: the stair blocks at the 5th riser under the slab edge (x=8.05), terrace/balcony/front door are unreachable, and balusters float and clash with the glass balustrade

pieces.name: Exterior finish
pieces.verdict: HF2 wins 5/5 blind pairs: clean facade geometry, but flat untextured render, black matte anthracite, sky-only glass
pieces.gap: The white render and anthracite panels are flat untextured colours (roughness 1, no maps), so the house's largest surfaces read as clean CG next to HF2; add fine render normal/roughness/albedo variation with base grime and a satin RAL 7016 anthracite.

log.m: Paused for usage limit: all agents stopped mid-round (P01 r3, P03 r2, P04, P05, P07 building; P02 r2 and P06 r1 critics unfinished). State committed and pushed.

P04 cut landscape to ~1.37M tris (from ~4M incl. shadows). Furniture is now the bottleneck (2.25M tris + 1.7M shadow, ~1650 draw calls; 32 fps vs 105+ without it). P07 given a 600k-tri / 350-draw-call budget.

P03 critic r1: HF2 won 5/5. Gap: white render and anthracite panels are flat untextured colour, reading as clean CG. Builder sent back for round 2 (textured render, glass reflecting the garden, RAL 7016 panels).
Resumed after stalls and a usage-limit pause: P01 r3, P04, P05, P07 builders and P02/P03/P06 critics continuing (hard timeouts added to browser waits).

P03: exterior.js materials (render, RAL7016, formwork concrete, larch, Fresnel glass) + exterior_detail.glb (2.3k tris: fascia joints, pergola beams, screen, surrounds, garage grooves, up/down wall lights); 0 errors, 77 fps bench
Resumed after fifth usage-limit pause: P01 r3, P03, P04, P05, P07 builders and P02/P06 critics continuing.
Assets: foliage alpha fixed in 40 models (trees, shrubs, grass, flowers, pot plants).

Assets: foliage alpha fixed (40 models: 37 foliage GLBs incl. all tree/shrub/grass/flower/plant splits + sofa_fabric_3seat fringe, wine_bottles labels, broom bristles) - RGBA WebP, alphaMode MASK 0.5, same file/node names; public/assets 153 MB
